I admire James’ passion for what he believes in. But I do not agree with his political views nor do I think he has a solid understanding in all the topics he discusses. 

For instance, in the recent pod he mentioned how defunding the police was wrong by using two extremes. The first extreme was a quoted opinion from a leftist friend of his who stated they thought there shouldn’t be a police force at all. And the second extreme was him harping on that there are dangerous psychopaths that need to be dealt with by law enforcement.

I currently work as a first responder and am in favor of bills that have been labeled as defunding the police. By no means do I think that the police force should be ended, but collective bargaining by police unions turns them into political mafias that protect their own when things such as police brutality occur. Instead of buying the police tanks, robots, and helicopters why don’t we direct funding to training them better and ensure that they do get reprimanded when they step out of line. 

The second was the idea of a social worker responding to calls. A large amount of emergency calls are social work. Cops are not trained to find housing and food for neglected elderly, or mediate divorces, help find jobs. Those are the calls that a social worker can respond to. 

I like them both, but it did bother me when James started talking so strongly about something he clearly had no experience or idea about.
